purpose: Category-representative catalog photography for the 499,800 corpus products outside the 200-product exact-photography set. One plate per file, one file per generation.
provenance_note: A plate is verified to show the correct product category, the Mosaic set, and no third-party mark. It is NOT a photograph of the specific product whose card it appears on. Only installed rows in asset_labels_200.json carry product-bound provenance. Never describe a plate as product-verified.
distinctness_target: A results page renders 12 cards. cohort_plates_installed + plates in a category must reach 12 for that category's first page to repeat no photograph.

framings.F1: shown three-quarter front at eye level
framings.F2: shown in straight profile from the right, parallel to the frame
framings.F3: shown from an elevated forty-degree view looking down, angled diagonally across the frame
framings.F4: shown three-quarter from behind and to the left, so the back of the product faces the camera
framings.F5: shown from a low camera just above the surface, slightly foreshortened toward the viewer
framings.F6: shown from almost directly overhead as a flat lay

extra_constraints: Keycaps are completely blank. No printed legends, letters, numbers, symbols or icons of any kind on any key
No badge, nameplate or brand mark anywhere on the case, base or cable
No side logo, swoosh, stripe device, wordmark or heel badge. The upper and midsole are plain
No printed text on the tongue, heel tab, insole or outsole
The outer face of each earcup is a plain smooth surface: no logo, no badge, no engraved wordmark, no maker's mark
No lettering on the headband, sliders, buttons or ports
No brand plate on the base, backrest or gas lift, and no printed labels or care tags on the mesh or upholstery
The chair is empty: no person, no jacket, no bag on it
Every port is an unlabelled opening. No port legends, no icons, no letters beside any socket
No badge or nameplate on the top, front or base, and no lit indicator text
The front face is completely plain: no logo, no wordmark, no model number, no status text
No illuminated display and no lit ring showing characters
Where a console would sit there is a blank matte panel. No numbers, no readout, no speed or distance figures anywhere
No decal, stripe or wordmark on the side rails, the belt, the uprights or the deck, and no printed safety label
No density markings, size numbers or printed text on the foam, rubber or fabric
No end-cap badge, moulded wordmark or embossed logo
The height keypad is blank: no digits, no arrows, no memory-preset numbers
No brand plate on the frame, legs or desktop edge, and nothing resting on the desktop
No logo on the fabric, the grille or the base, and no printed control labels around any dial
No illuminated display and no visible speaker brand mark
No brand tag, care label or size label sewn into the fabric, and no printed text on any strap or buckle
The support stands alone: no chair, no seat back and no person in the frame

domain_neutral_note: Served when a category has no plate and no cohort plate of the same subject. A card showing a warm empty still-life reads as photography pending; a card showing another category's product is a factual error a participant will catch. These three replace the per-domain product photograph that mesh-wi-fi-systems, treadmills, sound-masking-devices and lumbar-supports resolve to today.
domain_neutral_constraints: There is no product in the frame. Do not add a device, a shoe, a chair or any merchandise
The composition must still be a photograph of a real surface, not a flat colour field
